description: Three copies of a four-dimensional chaotic attractor by Dadras and Momeni, meant as slow modulation: a central voice called Spawn and two offset ones, Mom and Dad, each with X, Y, Z and W outputs

params.text: Sets how fast the attractor is stepped, 261.63 steps a second at the centre, doubling for each unit of travel clockwise and halving for each unit counter-clockwise
Pushes Mom and Dad apart from Spawn by a fixed step each time the attractor advances, -1 to 1; the smallest setting grows into a large difference over time
Skews the timestep the derivative is divided by, -3 to 3, slowing Mom and quickening Dad, and the other way round on the far side of the centre
Splits the stepping rate of Mom and Dad either side of the rate Haste sets, -2 to 2, each unit of it halving one and doubling the other
Snaps Mom and Dad onto whatever coordinates Spawn has reached; a cable in the Sync jack replaces this button
Puts all three voices back to their starting coordinates and clears the drawn trails; a cable in the Reset jack replaces this button
Chooses which three of the four dimensions the screen draws: X, Y and Z at the bottom position, Z, Y and X in the middle, W, X and Y at the top, the third of each being the axis drawn as depth
Swaps the equation used for the W dimension, which makes the W outputs scratch about instead of curving; the hover text reads Scratch while it is on
Pulls Spawn toward Dad, adding up to one hundredth of the gap between them at every step
Pulls Spawn toward Mom, adding up to one hundredth of the gap between them at every step
Sets the first constant of the attractor, the whole travel mapping it from 5 to 9
Sets the second constant of the attractor, the whole travel mapping it from 22 to 45
Sets the third constant of the attractor, the whole travel mapping it from 6 to 12
Sets the fourth constant of the attractor, the whole travel mapping it from 1 to 4; the hover text calls this knob Throw where the panel prints Hold
Stops the attractor and hands the four Constants knobs over to setting the coordinates all three voices start from; the outputs hold their last value until it is pressed again

inputs.text: Added to the Haste knob, doubling the stepping rate of all three voices for every volt
Added to the Separation knob for the X and Y dimensions but subtracted from it for the Z dimension, so on Z the jack and the knob push opposite ways
Added to the Phase knob, one unit per volt, and the total is clamped to -3.14 and 3.14
Added to the Difference knob, one unit per volt, before Mom and Dad are pushed either side of the Haste rate
The absolute value of the voltage is added to the D knob, 5V giving the full amount, so a negative voltage pulls as hard as the same positive one does
The absolute value of the voltage is added to the M knob, 5V giving the full amount, so a negative voltage pulls as hard as the same positive one does
A rise past 1V snaps Mom and Dad onto whatever coordinates Spawn has reached
A rise past 1V puts all three voices back to their starting coordinates and clears the drawn trails
Added to the Force knob, one unit per volt, and the total is clamped to the knob's own range
Added to the Split knob, one unit per volt, and the total is clamped to the knob's own range
Added to the Dwell knob, one unit per volt, and the total is clamped to the knob's own range
Added to the Hold knob, one unit per volt, and the total is clamped to the knob's own range

outputs.text: The X coordinate of Mom, the copy pushed one way by Separation, -8V to 8V
The Y coordinate of Mom, the copy pushed one way by Separation, -8V to 8V
The Z coordinate of Mom, the copy pushed one way by Separation, -8V to 8V
The W coordinate of Mom, the fourth dimension added to the published equations, -8V to 8V
The X coordinate of Spawn, the copy the M and D knobs pull about, -8V to 8V
The Y coordinate of Spawn, the copy the M and D knobs pull about, -8V to 8V
The Z coordinate of Spawn, the copy the M and D knobs pull about, -8V to 8V
The W coordinate of Spawn, the fourth dimension added to the published equations, -8V to 8V
The X coordinate of Dad, the copy Separation pushes the opposite way from Mom, -8V to 8V
The Y coordinate of Dad, the copy Separation pushes the opposite way from Mom, -8V to 8V
The Z coordinate of Dad, the copy Separation pushes the opposite way from Mom, -8V to 8V
The W coordinate of Dad, the fourth dimension added to the published equations, -8V to 8V

notes: the screen draws a trail for each of the three voices, and the viewport turns slowly on its own, so a line climbing the screen does not mean a climbing output
any coordinate that passes 120 throws that voice back to its starting point, which is what keeps a runaway setting from stopping the module dead
every output is monophonic and clamped to -8V to 8V
